mapper.insert: insert into interview_review_task ( title, candidate_name, interview_role, original_filename, audio_object_key, audio_url, audio_content_type, audio_size, resume_filename, resume_object_key, resume_url, resume_content_type, resume_size, status, transcript_text, review_report, fail_reason, question_status, question_extracted_count, question_created_count, question_merged_count, question_fail_reason, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{title}, #{candidateName}, #{interviewRole}, #{originalFilename}, #{audioObjectKey}, #{audioUrl}, #{audioContentType}, #{audioSize}, #{resumeFilename}, #{resumeObjectKey}, #{resumeUrl}, #{resumeContentType}, #{resumeSize}, #{status}, #{transcriptText}, #{reviewReport}, #{failReason}, #{questionStatus}, #{questionExtractedCount}, #{questionCreatedCount}, #{questionMergedCount}, #{questionFailReason}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
select from interview_review_task
and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or candidate_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or interview_role like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or original_filename like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or resume_filename like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and status = #{status}
order by id desc
mapper.update: update interview_review_task set status = #{status}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update interview_review_task set status = 'TRANSCRIBING', transcript_text = null, fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update interview_review_task set status = 'TRANSCRIBED', transcript_text = #{transcriptText}, fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update interview_review_task set status = 'REVIEWING', fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update interview_review_task set status = 'DONE', review_report = #{reviewReport}, fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update interview_review_task set resume_filename = #{resumeFilename}, resume_object_key = #{resumeObjectKey}, resume_url = #{resumeUrl}, resume_content_type = #{resumeContentType}, resume_size = #{resumeSize}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update interview_review_task set question_status = 'PROCESSING', question_extracted_count = 0, question_created_count = 0, question_merged_count = 0, question_fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update interview_review_task set question_status = 'DONE', question_extracted_count = #{extractedCount}, question_created_count = #{createdCount}, question_merged_count = #{mergedCount}, question_fail_reason = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
